g.title: AC
g.text: S21 only — never S403 (mains) or X50A. Pin 1 left unconnected.

g.title: LS
g.text: non-inverting; 100-220 ohm series R on HV1/HV2 toward S21; ch 3-4 unused

g.title: F1
g.text: series on S21 pin 4 (alt. 500 mA fast fuse)

g.title: U1
g.text: input cap 25 V min; mount 25 mm min from XIAO antenna; ferrite + 10uF on 5V out
